CustomObject.description: Append-only ledger of Platform Events admitted by CursorBatchReplayGuard, one row per (channel, event identity). The unique Event_Key__c is what makes a redelivered event detectable: the guard inserts before dispatching, and a DUPLICATE_VALUE means the event was already processed. Deliberately has no relationship to CursorBatch_Job__c so rows survive both job completion and job deletion -- the 2026-08-24 redelivery incident replayed events up to 103 hours old, well past the lifetime of any job record. Retention is by age via CursorBatchLedgerCleanup, not by job state.
CustomObject.label: Cursor Batch Event Ledger
